name: LLVM IR
summary: The typed, SSA-based intermediate representation of the LLVM compiler infrastructure, with equivalent in-memory, human-readable assembly (.ll) and dense bitcode (.bc) forms; the target of Clang, rustc, Swift, Julia and many other front ends.

level_notes.1: No external standard: the LLVM Language Reference Manual is normative but evolves with each release (no stability guarantee beyond the bitcode compatibility policy). Formal semantics come from academic work (Vellvm, the PLDI 2017 poison/undef model, Alive2).
level_notes.0: llvm-project is the single reference implementation; file links point at main. Vellvm and Alive2 are independent executable semantics; llvmlite and Inkwell are third-party IR builders.
